title: An Algebraic Introduction to Persistence
summary: We introduce persistence with an emphasis on its algebraic foundations, using the representation theory of posets. Linear representations of posets arise in several areas of mathematics, including the representation theory of quivers and finite dimensional algebras, Morse theory and other areas of geometry, as well as topological inference and topological data analysis -- often via persistent homology.
